panels.description: Since kelpie serve started. A drop to zero is a restart.

panels.title: Agent hosts up
panels.description: Multi-host only: agents whose board is merged (fresh reports, clock in range), out of the agents the hub knows. Empty on a single host.

panels.title: Agent host up
panels.description: 1 while the agent's board is merged into the farm; 0: silent or its clock is out of range, and its tasks are not evaluated (docs/multi-host.md).

panels.title: Age of the last agent report
panels.description: Since the hub accepted the agent's last report. Silent after [hub] silent_after (90 s by default).

panels.description: Trailing-hour increase; a series appears with its first event.

panels.description: Trailing-hour increase; a series appears with its first event.

panels.description: Trailing-hour increase; a series appears with its first event.

panels.description: Held back by the ledger (duplicates and rate limits).

panels.description: Trailing-hour increase; a series appears with its first event.

panels.title: Open states by rule
panels.description: Long-lived alert states currently open.

panels.title: Idle agents by role
panels.description: Agent owners with no live session and no open task.

panels.title: Cards before work
panels.description: Cards in a status before any work starts (Hermes triage, scheduled), by the platform's own status (incident 17).

panels.title: Oldest card before work
panels.description: How long the oldest card in each pre-work status has sat there; rule 3 alerts past prework_after only when tasks depend on it.

panels.description: Trailing-hour increase; a series appears with its first event.

panels.title: GitHub requests per minute by outcome
Connector failing for
panels.description: While a connector step fails tick after tick, time since its last good tick. Past a rule's max_condition_age (15 min by default) its conditions are stale and no rule acts on them (alert KelpieConnectorFailing).

panels.title: Quota remaining and limit
panels.description: In the provider's own unit.

panels.title: Limit hits and probe failures per hour
panels.description: Trailing-hour increase; a series appears with its first event.

panels.title: Resource read failures per hour by cause
panels.description: Trailing-hour increase; a series appears with its first event.

panels.title: Alerts delivered per hour by channel
panels.description: Trailing-hour increase of alerts handed to the chat service successfully.

panels.title: Lost alerts per hour by channel and cause
panels.description: Alerts Kelpie gave up on after retrying for retry_horizon (or at once for a rejection). Anything above zero means a human may have missed an alert; the KelpieAlertDeliveryFailed Prometheus rule fires on it. A series appears with its first event.

panels.title: Dropped alerts per hour by channel and reason
panels.description: Alerts dropped before delivery: duplicate (merged), queue_full or shutdown. A series appears with its first event.

panels.title: Tasks completed per hour by role (24h average)
panels.description: Tasks of the role that reached done in the last 24h, per hour. The board's own lookback bounds how far back done tasks are visible.

panels.title: Agents with work by role (share)
panels.description: Share of the role's agents with a live session or an open task, as the bottlenecks rule counts them. Not the daily report's utilization (session hours over agent-hours).

panels.title: Ownerless queue by role
panels.description: Ownerless tasks waiting for the role (ready, review, accepted). The daily report's queue also counts owned tasks waiting for their agent.

panels.title: Open tasks by stage
panels.description: Open tasks per stage now: working (a session runs), queue, review, waiting (for conditions), ownerless. Averaged over a range, the average number of tasks in each stage.

panels.title: Returns per done task by role (24h)
panels.description: Returns in the last 24h, counted for the role that redoes the work (not the reviewer that sent it back), over the tasks done in that time by the task's role, and the share of the role's completions reopened after done. Where tasks finish under another role's assignment (a reviewer's), the ratio mixes the two; the daily report's rework rate (share of the tasks a role worked on that came back to it) is the precise one.

panels.title: Done tasks reopened by role (24h)
panels.description: Done tasks of the role moved back out of done in the last 24h.

panels.title: Bill and estimate per provider (newest reconciled day)
panels.description: What the provider's cost report billed for its newest reconciled UTC day, and what Kelpie priced from traces for the same day.

panels.title: Spend gap (estimate vs bill)
panels.description: (estimate - bill) / bill. Negative: traces show less than was billed (spend Kelpie does not see). Absent when the bill is 0 or a credit.

panels.title: Age of the newest reconciled day
panels.description: Since the start (UTC midnight) of the newest day reconciled. Over two days: the cost report has not been read for a while.

panels.title: Cost report read
panels.description: 1 when the provider's last cost report read worked.

panels.title: Snooze buttons per hour by outcome
panels.description: Presses of the snooze buttons under alerts (snoozed, rejected, failed).

panels.title: Ignored presses per hour by reason
panels.description: Presses and updates ignored: unknown user, wrong chat, expired or used reference, rate limited, malformed. unknown_user or wrong_chat in numbers: someone else can press the buttons.

panels.title: Chat API errors per hour
panels.description: Failed Bot API calls of the button poller.

panels.title: Tool slots held by holder
panels.description: Shared tool slots (simulator lock files, [adapters.hermes.tools]) held by agents and by CI, against the pool's size.

panels.title: Toolchain versions per host
panels.description: From scripts/kelpie-toolchain.sh via node_exporter's textfile collector (incident 20). A version change shortly before an outage is named in the report.

panels.title: Processes per user and limit
panels.description: From scripts/kelpie-process-limit.sh (macOS: node_exporter has no process collector there).

panels.title: Watched directory sizes
panels.description: From scripts/kelpie-path-sizes.sh (incident 19): the directories rule 7 names when a disk fills.

panels.title: Watched directory growth per day
panels.description: Growth over the last 6 hours, per day; rule 7's default growth window.

panels.title: Traces token file read
panels.description: 0: the last read of [traces] token_file failed and Kelpie keeps the tokens it read before: a rotation or revocation has not taken effect.

panels.title: Rotated-out tokens accepted
panels.description: Previous tokens still accepted within [traces] token_grace.

panels.title: Requests on a rotated-out token per minute
panels.description: OTLP requests authenticated by a previous token: exporters not yet on the new one. Should reach zero before the grace period ends.
